cost.amortization: source build charged to first arm repetition
cost.denominator: unique detected truth labels divided by fully allocated cost

deduplication: one credit per protected truth challenge; repeated observation adds no denominator
feasibility_exception: No arm executes before corpus approval; VM feasibility remains not-run.

feedback_policy.permitted: challenge IDs and aggregate pass/fail only
feedback_policy.prohibited: labels, expected behavior, holdout membership, protected seeds

stopping.ties: lower public ID after exact defect-deduplication

uncertainty: bootstrap 95% interval over challenge labels and three fixed-seed repetitions
